caption: A lively, cozy pedestrian street is bathed in yellow and white holiday lights, filled with people and storefronts under a cheerful, festive atmosphere. The scene depicts a bustling pedestrian street at night, illuminated by festive yellow and white Christmas lights strung overhead. People stroll along the cobblestone street, some window shopping at the stores lining the sides. A Christmas tree adorned with lights stands near the camera. The atmosphere is lively and festive, with a warm, yellow-toned lighting creating a cozy ambiance. The overall tone is cheerful and inviting, capturing the spirit of the holiday season.
